backward-chaining.title: Backward chaining
backward-chaining.script: Start from the end and walk backwards. The end is a signed contract, and you walk back until the next step is in your own hands, because do sales is too vague to start on a Monday.

the-claim.title: The claim
the-claim.script: Here is the claim: sales has three stages, leads, opportunities and closing. The first steps are ones you control, and only after them does it become a numbers game.

signposting.title: Signposting
signposting.script: We go left to right. First the stages, then a deal board to track them, then marketing, and then the cashflow board once more.
